note: Holomorphy, continuity in space and agreement at imaginary times (the identity-theorem input) are in `Region`; the operator formula for F_n^xi, independence of eps, extension by zero outside ordered times and the eps=delta/8 bound have no Lean counterpart.

snippet.text:
structure Region (T : Table L) : Prop where
  together (n : ℕ) (v : Fin n → S.Union) : ContinuousOn (fun p : Times n × SpacePoints n =>
    P.F n p.1 p.2 v) (strict n ×ˢ univ)
  hol (n : ℕ) (v : Fin n → S.Union) (x : SpacePoints n) :
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun z => P.F n z x v) (strict n)
  roots (n : ℕ) (v : Fin n → S.Tag) (x : SpacePoints n) (y : Heights n) (hy : y ∈ east n) :
    P.F n (fun i => ↑(y i)*I) x (fun i => S.pin (v i).1 (v i).2) = S.useAt T (place x y) v

proof_context.conclusion: `Region` states joint continuity and holomorphy in the times on `strict n` and the agreement of the continuation with the Euclidean correlation `useAt` at imaginary times.

snippet.text:
lemma strict_evaluation (x : Points n) (v : Fin n → S.Union) {y : Heights n} (hy : y∈east n) :
    Continuous (fun i => (L.contours i).waves.restricted v y x) ∧
     (∫ i, (L.contours i).waves.restricted v y x ∂F.α.space.μ)=F.B.waves.restricted v y x := by
  obtain ⟨k,hk,δ,hδ,H⟩ := path_open y x hy

proof_context.conclusion: At strict heights the continued function is continuous in the phase and its phase average is the mixed one.
